case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NO. …. OF 2023 (@ SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (C) NO. 28241 OF 2019)
summary: Election petition challenging election validity due to alleged suppression of spouse's income tax details in Form 26 affidavit; failure to plead material facts under Section 83(1)(a) RP Act; incomplete cause of action per Section 100(1)(d)(iv); non-disclosure of foreign income tax status not mandatory where columns deemed inapplicable; Union of India v. Association for Democratic Reforms distinguished; High Court order dismissing pretrial applications set aside; election upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Representation of the People Act, 1951 s.80, s.80A, s.81, s.83, s.86, s.100(1)(d)(iv)
Constitution of India Art. 324, Art. 325, Art. 326, Art. 327
Union of India vs. Association for Democratic Reforms & Anr.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned High Court order set aside; election petition proceedings permitted to continue on merits.
